### 🤖 Bots in PvP
- PvP rooms can now start with up to 9 bots — pick how many and how good (Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert) when you create the game
- Bots play like players: same health, guns and movement, they hear shots and footsteps, flick and settle their aim, strafe in fights and back off when losing
- Bots are clearly marked with a BOT tag and give up their slot when a real player joins a full room
- Bots fight in every PvP mode and respect teams in Team Deathmatch
- Hosting a room full of bots no longer stutters

### 🎮 Bot lobbies & Quick play
- Three bot lobbies are always open in the Join tab — the first player in starts it, everyone after joins, and if the host leaves the room carries on with someone else hosting
- Bot lobbies rotate through maps: after every match the room moves on to the next map
- New Quick play button in the main menu drops you straight into a PvP match: a player room if there is one, otherwise a bot lobby
- Redesigned Join tab: player rooms and bot lobbies as map cards showing live state, player count and bot difficulty; PvP now opens on Join
- Players now notice within seconds when a host’s game crashes, instead of being stuck with frozen opponents

### 🖥️ Menus
- PvP, PvE, Profile and Settings now open as full screens instead of pop-up windows
- Settings explain what each option does when you point at it
- The pause menu, inventory, buy menu and trader now open as full screens over the paused game, matching the main menu
- Saved survival worlds show up as cards with a picture of the world taken while you played it
- World names are tidied up and limited to 32 characters
- Key bindings are grouped into Movement, Combat and Interaction
- Refreshed loading screen

### ⚔️ Gameplay
- The kill feed highlights your own kills and deaths, newest line at the bottom
- With the Unlimited economy, the loadout you put together in warmup is kept when the match starts
- Weapon inspect in third person looks natural: the hand turns with the weapon
### 🔫 Weapons
- Guns have new names: KR-47, AR-4, F-Clairon, Grizzly, Ranger, PDW-90, LMG-5, Hand Cannon and Silenced Pistol — your saved worlds keep their guns
- Your gun no longer sinks into walls when you stand right in front of one
- The gun reacts to jumps and falls: it trails in the air, dips a little on a jump and harder on a big drop
- Drawing a weapon now has a sound — a holster pull and the gun's own rack or bolt, a blade draw for the knife
- With a scope fully up, your arms and flying brass no longer cut into the scope view
- The Grizzly's stock no longer peeks in under the scope picture at full zoom
- A drawn weapon settles into its idle sway instead of jumping the moment the draw ends

### 🧟 Mutants
- The mutant roster is cut to four that each read at a glance: **Stilted**, **Horned**, **Hydra** and the new **Deviant**. Grafted, Runt, Maw, Stitched, Blob, Ox, Lope and Centaur are gone
- New rare mutant, the **Deviant** — a big, fast predator of cords and hooked mandibles whose back sails flare when it bites
- The **Hydra** is rebuilt and much bigger: dark scales, glowing veins, long swan necks with manes and biting jaws
- The Hydra's heads are alive: they look around on their own, rear up and hiss when the creature notices you, and strike one after another behind the biting head, each jaw opening on its own lunge
- The Hydra no longer leaves severed heads behind when it dies
- The **Horned** is now a blocky brute in the same box body as the horde and the player, with the mutant face cut into the cube
- Zombies now really blend between poses — raising arms, swinging, settling — instead of holding the old pose and snapping

### 🎒 Items
- Dropped items arc, tumble, bounce once and then lie on the ground following its slope, instead of hovering and spinning
- Dropped grenades are hand-sized

### ⏸️ Pause menu & buy menu
- New two-column pause menu: Resume, Unstuck me and Main menu on the left, settings on the right
- **Unstuck me** moves you to the nearest free spot instead of killing you; you only respawn when there is none nearby
- The PvP buy menu is laid out as one band per loadout slot: your current weapon on the left, and beside it every item that would replace it, so a purchase is a move along one row
- Axes and picks are no longer sold in PvP — there is nothing to chop or mine in an arena
- The inventory in PvP is smaller and no longer stretches across the whole screen; the buy menu and inventory sit as centred blocks on 1440×900 and larger
- The lobby fits a 1440-wide window: the map gallery no longer collapses to a sliver, and the mode · map title wraps instead of being cut off
- The lobby's connection check no longer jumps around while it re-measures

### 🎬 Story cutscenes
- A new survival world now opens with a cinematic intro. You come to on your back in the forest while a stranger, the Drifter, guns down two of the dead closing in on you with an AK.
- He drags you back to your senses by a fire and points you at the work ahead, then walks off into the fog. The campfire he leaves behind is real, so you can use it.
- The scene is fully voiced, with subtitles, lip-synced dialogue and acted characters.
- In co-op, everyone in the world watches the intro together. Nobody can be hurt while it plays, and creatures leave you alone.
- Each story scene plays once per world and is saved with it.
